name: WPR106-75 BTCUSDT no-RSI KNN four-bar compact matrix

experiments.name: 15m 1h price path lorentzian uniform same
experiments.config_data_change: No-RSI price close path feature pack with uniform Lorentzian same-regime neighbors.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests whether short close-path analogues carry enough entry edge before exit changes.
experiments.risk: Missing close-return columns must be explicit in the dataset manifest before durable interpretation.

experiments.name: 15m 1h price path euclidean inverse compatible
experiments.config_data_change: No-RSI price close path with robust-z Euclidean distance and compatible regime matching.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Checks whether compatible regime borrowing improves trade count without collapsing expectancy.
experiments.risk: Compatible regime map can leak poor range-to-trend analogues if labels are weak.

experiments.name: 15m 1h price path cosine softmax all
experiments.config_data_change: No-RSI price close path with cosine distance and all-regime neighbor pool.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests whether shape similarity beats strict regime filtering at the 1h label.
experiments.risk: All-regime pools may improve count while reducing entry purity.

experiments.name: 15m 1h price vol flow lorentzian inverse compatible
experiments.config_data_change: Adds aggTrade/order-flow proxy columns to price path with Lorentzian inverse-distance weighting.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Flow context should improve entry quality if same-price path alone is too noisy.
experiments.risk: Flow proxy columns are not L2 OFI and must stay tagged as proxy context.

experiments.name: 15m 1h price vol flow euclidean softmax all
experiments.config_data_change: Price/vol/flow pack with robust-z Euclidean softmax and all-regime matching.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests whether flow plus broad neighbor pool can lift 1h expectancy after costs.
experiments.risk: All-regime row must beat no-trade and fixed holding, not only improve trade count.

experiments.name: 15m 1h price vol flow cosine uniform same
experiments.config_data_change: Price/vol/flow pack with cosine distance and uniform same-regime neighbors.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests whether flow-shape similarity works without distance concentration.
experiments.risk: Uniform weighting may underuse strong nearest-neighbor separation.

experiments.name: 15m 1h perp context lorentzian softmax all
experiments.config_data_change: Perp-context pack with Lorentzian softmax and all-regime matching.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Checks whether funding, premium, OI, and flow context carry the lead without RSI.
experiments.risk: Perp context can be latest-window biased if the input manifest is not durable.

experiments.name: 15m 1h perp context euclidean uniform same
experiments.config_data_change: Perp-context pack with robust-z Euclidean distance and uniform same-regime neighbors.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests if non-price context is stable enough within regimes at a 1h label.
experiments.risk: Sparse or missing OI/premium features can flatten the neighbor space.

experiments.name: 15m 1h perp context cosine inverse compatible
experiments.config_data_change: Perp-context pack with cosine distance, inverse-distance weighting, and compatible regimes.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Checks whether perp-context directionality survives a looser regime match.
experiments.risk: Compatible mode must not rely on one split dominating PnL.

experiments.name: 1h 4h price path lorentzian uniform same
experiments.config_data_change: No-RSI price close path at the 1h base interval mapped to a 4h horizon.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests whether a slower four-bar close path reduces churn and cost drag.
experiments.risk: Requires 1h event labels generated from signal close plus four completed bars.

experiments.name: 1h 4h price path euclidean inverse compatible
experiments.config_data_change: No-RSI price close path at 4h horizon with robust-z Euclidean compatible regimes.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests whether a larger K and compatible regimes help slower labels.
experiments.risk: Higher K can average away sparse lead behavior.

experiments.name: 1h 4h price path cosine softmax all
experiments.config_data_change: No-RSI price close path at 4h horizon with cosine softmax all-regime matching.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests whether slower shape similarity can overcome strict-regime sparsity.
experiments.risk: All-regime matching must survive split and cost stress.

experiments.name: 1h 4h price vol flow lorentzian inverse compatible
experiments.config_data_change: Price/vol/flow pack at 4h horizon with Lorentzian inverse-distance compatible regimes.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests whether flow context selects better four-hour continuation events.
experiments.risk: Flow context must be built from durable aggTrade rows, not latest-window proxies.

experiments.name: 1h 4h price vol flow euclidean softmax all
experiments.config_data_change: Price/vol/flow pack at 4h horizon with robust-z Euclidean softmax all-regime matching.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Checks broad 4h analogues for costed continuation quality.
experiments.risk: Trade count can improve while net edge remains negative.

experiments.name: 1h 4h price vol flow cosine uniform same
experiments.config_data_change: Price/vol/flow pack at 4h horizon with cosine uniform same-regime neighbors.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests a low-assumption no-distance-weighting flow analogue row.
experiments.risk: Same-regime restriction can undertrade if the HMM posterior is noisy.

experiments.name: 1h 4h perp context lorentzian softmax all
experiments.config_data_change: Perp-context pack at 4h horizon with Lorentzian softmax all-regime matching.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests whether funding, basis, OI, and flow state matter more at a slower horizon.
experiments.risk: Perp rows are blocked if OI/premium/funding manifests are latest-window only.

experiments.name: 1h 4h perp context euclidean uniform same
experiments.config_data_change: Perp-context pack at 4h horizon with robust-z Euclidean uniform same-regime neighbors.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests whether same-regime perp context has stable non-RSI entry quality.
experiments.risk: Missing context columns must not be silently interpreted as real neutral values.

experiments.name: 1h 4h perp context cosine inverse compatible
experiments.config_data_change: Perp-context pack at 4h horizon with cosine inverse-distance compatible regimes.
experiments.expected_metric_movement: Tests whether perp-context similarity benefits from compatible regime pooling.
experiments.risk: Must pass cost stress and split dominance gates before any larger validation packet.
